---
title: "Short^[Titlenote set beside the title, long enough to run over several lines of the margin column.]"
reference-location: margin
format:
  mcanouil-typst:
    keep-typ: true
extensions:
  mcanouil:
    preset: terminal
    type: article
_quarto:
  tests:
    run:
      extension-test:
        description: A margin note in the title on page 1 of the terminal article is moved below the shapes of the corner motif.
        check: bash _checks/article.sh short terminal
    mcanouil-typst:
      ensureTypstFileRegexMatches:
        - ['mcanouil-document\(\s*"article",\s*"standard",\s*none']
